description: Expander for the Euclidean Sequencer, placed immediately to the right of it, turning that sequencer's steps into a stepped control voltage

params.text: Sets the voltage for that step of the expander's own eight step sequence, with SCALE setting the top of the range
Sets the highest voltage the step knobs reach, from 1V to 8V
Chooses what advances the expander: HIT steps on every hit from the sequencer, CLK on every clock the sequencer receives, REST on every rest

outputs.text: The voltage of the step the expander has reached
The voltage of the step the expander has reached, with its sign reversed
A gate following whichever source the CLOCK switch selects

menu: Channel — sets the colour of the step knobs, Channel 1 (Red) through to Channel 7 (Green), so that stacked expanders can be told apart
Initialize CV Values Only — puts the eight step knobs back to their default positions
Randomize CV Values Only — sets the eight step knobs at random
Zero CV Values — turns all eight step knobs down to 0V
